sentences.en: Everyone strives for efficiency but few seem to attain it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在追求效率，但似乎很少有人能达到。

sentences.en: Chandrika was not reborn, as her soul had attained nirvana.
sentences.zh: Chandrika 并没有转世投胎，因为她的灵魂已经达到了涅槃。

sentences.en: Perseverance is the most important quality needed to attain success.
sentences.zh: 成功最重要的品质就是坚持不懈。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：at+tain（拿住）→稳稳拿住→获得
